title: 5 Places HVAC Shops Leak Money (Scorecard Carousel)

slides.headline: 5 places your HVAC shop is leaking money
slides.body: Score yourself as you swipe. Most shops are leaking 3 of the 5.

slides.headline: LEAK 1 — Missed calls
slides.body: Home-service shops miss about 27% of inbound calls. Each one: $500–$1,200. Leaking if: after-hours calls go to voicemail.

slides.headline: LEAK 2 — Dead estimates
slides.body: Typical shops close 23–30% of quotes. The other 70% walk — and most never get a single follow-up. Leaking if: you don't know your open-estimate count right now.

slides.headline: LEAK 3 — Thin reviews
slides.body: 91% of homeowners check reviews before choosing an HVAC contractor. 40 reviews vs. a competitor's 400 = invisible on the map. Leaking if: your techs "forget" to ask.

slides.headline: LEAK 4 — Office admin
slides.body: You (or your spouse) doing invoices, scheduling, and paperwork at 9pm. That's owner hours spent on $15/hr work. Leaking if: the same job gets typed into 3 different systems.

slides.headline: LEAK 5 — Feast or famine
slides.body: Shoulder-season calls drop 30–40%. Overhead doesn't. 40% of HVAC owners say cash flow is problem #1. Leaking if: your only slow-season plan is "hope."

slides.headline: Scored 3 or more? You're normal. And leaking.
slides.body: I'm breaking down every leak — with dollar math — over the next few weeks. Follow so you don't miss your leak. Save this as your checklist.
